sections.content:
11,270 people

were counted on the census as "vehicle paint technicians" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Vehicle paint technicians apply paint, cellulose, vinyl stickers and wraps and other protective or decorative materials to the bodywork of motor vehicles.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "vehicle paint technicians" there were more men than women (97.5% compared with 2.5%).

This means "vehicle paint technicians" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades".

Men made up 97.5% and women made up 2.5% of "vehicle paint technicians"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "vehicle paint technicians" included:

  • groundsmen and greenkeepers
  • sheet metal workers
  • tyre, exhaust and windscreen fitters

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "vehicle paint technicians" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "vehicle paint technicians", 12.4% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "vehicle paint technicians" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "vehicle paint technicians" included:

  • food, drink and tobacco process operatives
  • glaziers, window fabricators and fitters
  • bakers and flour confectioners

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "vehicle paint technicians", 7.1% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (89% compared with 11%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (78.8%) than self-employed (21.2%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
